executor: tools.idle_consensus_auto_merge:evaluate_auto_merge_gate(apply=True, carry_forward, receipt_bundle_path): the published receipt-path API; the merge executor writes its own receipt each run and has no caller receipt path, so it is not a replay surface here and none is invented
tuple_error: carry receipt belongs to another repository/PR/task/head/base
harness: real git on the allowlisted MAGMA path (fresh history per case); synthetic strict GitHub only (recorded calls, never a live PR); actual MAGMA writer and semantic consumer
per_case_steps: source: actual writer writes bundle B at the source tuple; the actual consumer accepts B there (creation-time validity) and B carries exactly the source tuple
target: the actual writer writes a fresh bundle at the target (complete live target derivation; a refusal here is reported as a constructor failure, never as a binding pass)

replay: B offered to the idle executor at the target with apply true: zero synthetic merge commands and no mutating GitHub call, carry_apply_verification refuses with the tuple error, the direct consumer refuses B with the same text, and the set of differing outer tuple fields equals changed_receipt_fields
positive control: the fresh target bundle is accepted by the consumer and the idle executor merges exactly once at the target head

proposed_head_replay.setup: same repository, PR, task, approved head and base; target head C = git commit-tree of the B tree with the same parent (live base) and another message; synthetic PR head and required check runs move to C; original rows unchanged

base_advance_replay.setup: target base Y = empty-content child of the live base X (same tree); target head C = B tree with parent Y; synthetic base ref and tip move to Y, required check runs to C; approved head and basis unchanged (legal same-content carry to a new base)

repository_replay.setup: second test-owned git repository with the same object graph and origin URL of the target repository; original rows kept, authenticated original-voter basis rows for the target repository appended (later minutes); synthetic PR and CI under the target repository; PR, task, heads and base unchanged

task_replay.setup: repository, PR, heads and base unchanged; synthetic branch and task become the target task; original rows kept, a valid author claim plus each original voter's own basis-bound row on the target task appended (no proxy issuer); adaptation: the source claim binds its task only (no PR number field), because a PR-bound claim on the old task makes the target unresolvable (see task_axis_pr_bound_claim_control)

task_axis_pr_bound_claim_control.meaning: source claim with the PR number field (corpus default): the published author resolution classifies the old-task claim as a non-canonical contributor claim on the target task, so the target carry does not derive (constructor-failure branch of the design); B offered there refuses with zero synthetic effects
task_axis_pr_bound_claim_control.writer_error: carry PR author is not bound to the current snapshot
task_axis_pr_bound_claim_control.observed_resolution_reason: non-canonical contributor claim(s) bind this PR: claude-rco-2
